preconditions.description: The number of queries q is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(a, str) and isinstance(b, str) and 1 <= len(a) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(b) <= 100000 for a, b in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two non-empty strings a and b with lengths up to 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in a) and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in b) for a, b in queries)
preconditions.description: All characters in strings a and b are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(a) for a, b in queries) <= 200000 and sum(len(b) for a, b in queries) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of lengths of all a strings and all b strings across queries does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == '-1') or (is_palindrome(output_lines[i]) and exists_valid_decomposition(output_lines[i], queries[i][0], queries[i][1])) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the output is either '-1' or a valid palindromic string S that can be decomposed into a non-empty substring of a and a non-empty substring of b.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == '-1') or (is_maximal_length(output_lines[i], queries[i][0], queries[i][1]) and is_lexicographically_first(output_lines[i], queries[i][0], queries[i][1])) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: If a valid string exists for query i, the output string has the maximum possible length among all valid strings, and among those with maximum length, it is the lexicographically smallest.

semantic_helpers.exists_valid_decomposition: lambda s, a, b: any((s.startswith(sa) and s.endswith(sb) and len(sa) >= 1 and len(sb) >= 1 and sa in a and sb in b) for sa in (s[:k] for k in range(1, len(s))) for sb in (s[k:] for k in range(1, len(s))))
semantic_helpers.is_maximal_length: lambda s, a, b: all(len(s) >= len(s2) for s2 in all_valid_strings(a, b))
semantic_helpers.is_lexicographically_first: lambda s, a, b: all(s <= s2 for s2 in all_valid_strings(a, b) if len(s2) == len(s))
semantic_helpers.all_valid_strings: lambda a, b: [sa + sb for sa in (a[i:j] for i in range(len(a)) for j in range(i+1, len(a)+1)) for sb in (b[k:l] for k in range(len(b)) for l in range(k+1, len(b)+1)) if is_palindrome(sa + sb)]
